questions.explanationZh: 低体温心脏骤停：按指征最多电击 3 次，之后持续 CPR 并快速转运——3 次电击后【不再】为分析或电击而中断按压。低温心脏在医院复温前对除颤反应差；低体温也是支持骤停中转运的可逆病因。

questions.questionEn: Why must a severely hypothermic patient be moved gently and spared any rough handling?
questions.questionZh: 为什么重度低体温患者必须轻柔搬动、避免任何粗暴操作？

options.en: Cold bones fracture easily during movement
options.zh: 低温下骨骼在搬动中容易骨折

options.en: Rough handling accelerates heat loss through convection
options.zh: 粗暴搬动会通过对流加速失温

options.en: Movement causes rapid rewarming shock
options.zh: 搬动会引起快速复温休克

options.en: The cold myocardium is irritable, and jarring can precipitate ventricular fibrillation
options.zh: 低温心肌应激性高，颠簸震动可诱发室颤

questions.explanationEn: "Avoid rough handling" is listed for severe hypothermia because the cold myocardium is electrically irritable — mechanical jarring can trigger ventricular fibrillation, an arrest rhythm that is especially hard to defibrillate while the core remains cold.
questions.explanationZh: 重度低体温强调"避免粗暴搬动"，因为低温心肌电活动极不稳定——机械震动可触发室颤，而核心体温未恢复前这种心律极难除颤成功。

questions.questionEn: A newborn delivered unexpectedly at home is wet and starting to look mottled in a cool room. The FIRST defence against hypothermia is to:
questions.questionZh: 一名在家中意外分娩的新生儿浑身湿润，在凉爽的房间里皮肤开始出现花斑。防止低体温的第一道防线是：

options.en: Dry the baby, remove wet coverings, and cover with warm dry blankets
options.zh: 擦干婴儿、撤掉湿的包裹物，用温暖干燥的毯子包好

options.en: Immerse the baby in warm water
options.zh: 将婴儿浸入温水

options.en: Place hot packs directly against the baby's skin
options.zh: 把热敷袋直接贴在婴儿皮肤上

options.en: Open a window for fresh air circulation
options.zh: 打开窗户保持空气流通

questions.explanationEn: Hypothermia care begins with removing wet and cold clothing and covering with blankets or dry clothing — and newborn care specifically starts with dry, stimulate, keep warm. Evaporation from wet skin is a massive heat drain in neonates; direct hot packs burn fragile skin.
questions.explanationZh: 低体温处理首先是除去湿冷衣物并以毯子或干衣物覆盖——新生儿处理更是以"擦干、刺激、保暖"开始。湿润皮肤的蒸发对新生儿是巨大的失温途径；热敷袋直贴会烫伤娇嫩皮肤。

questions.questionEn: A 10-year-old fell through pond ice and was quickly pulled out. He is alert and shivering violently, estimated core temperature 33°C. Management should include:
questions.questionZh: 一名 10 岁儿童踩破池塘冰面落水，很快被救出。他神志清楚、剧烈寒战，估计核心体温 33°C。处理应包括：

options.en: Leaving wet clothes on to avoid exposure
options.zh: 为避免暴露保留湿衣物

options.en: Removing wet clothing and actively rewarming with warm blankets and wrapped hot packs
options.zh: 脱去湿衣物，用保暖毯和包裹的热敷袋积极复温

options.en: No rewarming — treat like severe hypothermia
options.zh: 不复温——按重度低体温处理

options.en: Ice-water immersion to prevent afterdrop
options.zh: 浸冰水以防"后降效应"

questions.explanationEn: At 33°C with shivering and alertness this is mild hypothermia (32-35°C): remove wet and cold clothing, then actively rewarm — warm blankets, hot packs wrapped in towels, ambulance preheated to 30°C. The no-rewarming rule applies only below 28°C.
questions.explanationZh: 33°C、寒战且清醒属轻度低体温（32-35°C）：脱去湿冷衣物后积极复温——保暖毯、毛巾包裹热敷袋、车内预热 30°C。"不复温"规则只适用于 28°C 以下。

questions.questionEn: For a heatstroke patient, cooling efforts on scene should continue for a minimum of how long before beginning conveyance to hospital?
questions.questionZh: 对中暑（heatstroke）患者，现场降温至少应持续多长时间后才开始向医院转运？

options.en: 2 minutes
options.zh: 2 分钟

options.en: 30 seconds — transport always comes first
options.zh: 30 秒——转运永远优先

options.en: 10 minutes
options.zh: 10 分钟

options.en: 60 minutes
options.zh: 60 分钟

questions.explanationEn: Continue cooling efforts for a minimum of 10 minutes prior to beginning conveyance, then apply the most aggressive cooling method available during transport until treatment endpoints are reached. In heatstroke, cooling IS the life-saving treatment.
questions.explanationZh: 转运前现场降温至少持续 10 分钟，随后在转运途中继续采用可行的最强降温手段直至达到处理终点。对中暑而言，降温本身就是救命治疗。

questions.questionEn: Which combination of cooling measures does the guideline list for heatstroke?
questions.questionZh: 指南为中暑列出的降温措施组合是哪一项？

options.en: Fanning only, with clothing left in place
options.zh: 仅扇风，衣物保持原样

options.en: Cold shower and antipyretic medication
options.zh: 冲冷水澡并给退烧药

options.en: Alcohol sponge baths over the whole body
options.zh: 全身酒精擦浴

options.en: Remove all clothing, cold wet towels to head/torso/thighs, feet and legs immersed in ice water, AC on maximum
options.zh: 脱去全部衣物、头/躯干/大腿敷冷湿毛巾、双足小腿浸入冰水、空调开到最冷

questions.explanationEn: The guideline: remove all clothing; begin convective cooling with air conditioning at maximum cold; apply cold wet towels to head, torso and thighs; immerse feet and legs in a bucket or basin of ice water. Antipyretics do not work in heatstroke.
questions.explanationZh: 指南：脱去全部衣物；空调最冷档对流降温；头、躯干、大腿敷冷湿毛巾；双足及小腿浸入冰水桶/盆。退烧药对中暑无效。

questions.questionEn: During a heat wave, an 88-year-old in a top-floor apartment without air conditioning is found confused with hot, dry skin. The EMR should recognize:
questions.questionZh: 热浪期间，一名住在无空调顶层公寓的 88 岁老人被发现意识混乱、皮肤又热又干。EMR 应认识到：

options.en: Heat stroke — an unstable patient needing immediate aggressive cooling and a blood glucose check
options.zh: 这是中暑（heat stroke）——不稳定患者，需立即强力降温并测血糖

options.en: Heat exhaustion — oral rehydration on scene is sufficient
options.zh: 这是热衰竭——现场口服补液即可

options.en: Probable stroke — cooling is contraindicated
options.zh: 多半是脑卒中——禁忌降温

options.en: Normal age-related confusion — no emergency exists
options.zh: 老年人常见的意识混乱——不构成急症

questions.explanationEn: Altered LOC with hot skin in a heat exposure context is heatstroke, listed as an unstable primary-survey finding. Move her to a cool area, remove clothing, cool aggressively for at least 10 minutes, and — because LOC is decreased — initial vitals must include a blood glucose measurement.
questions.explanationZh: 热暴露背景下意识改变加皮肤灼热即中暑，属初步评估的不稳定表现。移至阴凉处、除去衣物、强力降温至少 10 分钟，且因意识下降，初始生命体征必须包含血糖测量。

questions.questionEn: A 3-year-old was found in a locked hot car, lethargic and flushed. After removal from the car, the EMR's cooling strategy should be to:
questions.questionZh: 一名 3 岁幼儿被发现困在闷热的上锁汽车内，萎靡不振、面色潮红。抱离汽车后，EMR 的降温策略应是：

options.en: Wrap the child in blankets to prevent shivering
options.zh: 用毯子包住孩子防止寒战

options.en: Move to a cool area, remove clothing, begin cooling at once, and continue the most aggressive cooling available during transport
options.zh: 移到阴凉处、脱去衣物、立即开始降温，并在转运途中继续采用可行的最强降温手段

options.en: Give cold juice to drink and observe on scene
options.zh: 给冷果汁喝并留在现场观察

options.en: Transport immediately with no cooling — children cool themselves quickly
options.zh: 不降温立即转运——儿童自身散热很快

questions.explanationEn: Heatstroke management: move to a cool area, remove all clothing, begin convective and evaporative cooling immediately, continue at least 10 minutes before conveyance, and keep the most aggressive cooling running during transport. A lethargic child cannot safely drink; delaying cooling is the classic fatal error.
questions.explanationZh: 中暑处理：移至阴凉处、脱去全部衣物、立即开始对流+蒸发降温，转运前至少持续 10 分钟，途中继续最强降温。萎靡的幼儿不能安全饮水；延误降温是经典的致命错误。

questions.questionEn: A marathon runner with heatstroke has had 12 minutes of on-scene cooling and is now loaded. Your partner suggests stopping the cooling "so he doesn't get too cold" during the 20-minute transport. The correct approach is:
questions.questionZh: 一名中暑的马拉松选手已现场降温 12 分钟并装车。搭档建议 20 分钟的转运途中停止降温"免得他过冷"。正确做法是：

options.en: Stop all cooling once en route, as suggested
options.zh: 如建议所说，上路后停止一切降温

options.en: Alternate 5 minutes of cooling with 5 minutes of warming
options.zh: 降温 5 分钟、保暖 5 分钟交替进行

options.en: Continue the most aggressive cooling available during transport until recommended treatment endpoints are reached
options.zh: 转运途中继续可行的最强降温，直到达到推荐的处理终点

options.en: Switch to fanning only for the remainder of the trip
options.zh: 余下路程只用扇风

questions.explanationEn: The guideline is explicit: the most aggressive cooling method available should be applied during transport and continue until the recommended treatment endpoints are reached — continue evaporative cooling with soaked towels and convective cooling with the AC at maximum. Every minute hyperthermic extends organ damage.
questions.explanationZh: 指南明确：转运途中应采用可行的最强降温手段，直到达到推荐的处理终点——继续湿毛巾蒸发降温并将空调开到最冷对流降温。高热每多一分钟，器官损伤就多一分。

questions.questionEn: A heatstroke patient has a decreased level of consciousness. Which measurement MUST be included with the initial vital signs?
questions.questionZh: 一名中暑患者意识水平下降。初始生命体征中【必须】包含哪项测量？

options.en: Peak expiratory flow
options.zh: 呼气峰流速

options.en: 12-lead ECG interpretation
options.zh: 12 导联心电图判读

options.en: Urine output
options.zh: 尿量

options.en: Blood glucose
options.zh: 血糖

questions.explanationEn: The guideline: initial vital signs must include blood glucose measurement if there is decreased LOC. Hypoglycemia can mimic or complicate heat illness and is rapidly correctable.
questions.explanationZh: 指南规定：意识下降时初始生命体征必须包含血糖测量。低血糖可以模拟或并发热射病，且可被迅速纠正。

questions.questionEn: A teenage surfer was briefly submerged, then rescued. He is breathing adequately but coughing. How should he be positioned and managed?
questions.questionZh: 一名少年冲浪者短暂溺水后获救，呼吸尚可但咳嗽。应如何摆位和处理？

options.en: Sitting up, at rest, wet clothing removed, dried, and kept from further heat loss
options.zh: 坐位、静息，脱去湿衣、擦干并防止继续失温

options.en: Supine with legs elevated
options.zh: 平卧并抬高双腿

options.en: Walking on the beach to warm up
options.zh: 在沙滩上行走取暖

options.en: Prone to let water drain from the lungs
options.zh: 俯卧以便肺内水分流出

questions.explanationEn: Drowning/near-drowning care: keep the patient at rest, position sitting up, remove wet clothing and dry the patient, avoid rough handling, and maintain body temperature. "Draining" the lungs is a myth and walking increases workload.
questions.explanationZh: 溺水/近溺水处理：静息、坐位、脱湿衣擦干、避免粗暴搬动、维持体温。"控水"是误区，行走会增加机体负荷。

questions.questionEn: A 16-year-old dove head-first into a shallow lake and now floats face-down. After rescue, spinal motion restriction should be applied:
questions.questionZh: 一名 16 岁少年头朝下跳入浅水湖，随后面朝下漂浮。救出后，脊柱活动限制应当：

options.en: Never — drowning patients do not get spinal precautions
options.zh: 一律不用——溺水患者不做脊柱保护

options.en: Yes — as indicated by this diving mechanism of injury
options.zh: 应当采用——该跳水机制即为指征

options.en: Only if he complains of neck pain after waking
options.zh: 只有他醒来诉颈痛才用

options.en: Only when a physician orders it
options.zh: 必须有医生医嘱才用

questions.explanationEn: Drowning care directs: apply spinal motion restriction as indicated based on the mechanism of injury. A head-first dive into shallow water is a classic axial-loading cervical spine mechanism.
questions.explanationZh: 溺水指南要求：根据损伤机制按指征实施脊柱活动限制。头朝下跳入浅水是典型的颈椎轴向负荷机制。

questions.questionEn: A 5-year-old pulled from a pool is unresponsive with slow, gasping, inadequate breaths but a palpable pulse. The EMR should:
questions.questionZh: 一名从泳池救出的 5 岁儿童无反应，呼吸缓慢、喘息样、不充分，但可触及脉搏。EMR 应当：

options.en: Begin chest compressions immediately
options.zh: 立即开始胸外按压

options.en: Apply oxygen by mask and wait for improvement
options.zh: 面罩给氧并等待好转

options.en: Perform basic airway management and provide intermittent positive pressure ventilations (IPPV)
options.zh: 进行基础气道管理并给予间歇正压通气（IPPV）

options.en: Place him in the recovery position and suction only
options.zh: 摆复原卧位并只做吸引

questions.explanationEn: With a pulse present but failing respirations, the drowning guideline directs basic airway management and IPPV to support failing respirations. Compressions are for pulselessness (or HR <60 with poor perfusion in children); a mask alone cannot ventilate an apneic-trending child.
questions.explanationZh: 有脉搏但呼吸衰竭时，溺水指南要求基础气道管理并用 IPPV 支持衰竭的呼吸。按压用于无脉（或儿童心率 <60 伴灌注不良）；单纯面罩无法为濒临呼吸停止的儿童通气。

questions.questionEn: You are ALONE with an AED when you confirm a 14-year-old drowning victim is in cardiac arrest. What does the asphyxia-arrest guidance direct?
questions.questionZh: 你独自一人携带 AED，确认一名 14 岁溺水者心脏骤停。窒息性骤停的指引要求怎么做？

options.en: Apply the AED first and analyze before any CPR
options.zh: 先贴 AED 分析后再开始 CPR

options.en: Provide rescue breaths only for 10 minutes
options.zh: 只做人工呼吸 10 分钟

options.en: Compression-only CPR until help arrives
options.zh: 单纯按压直到支援到达

options.en: Give 5 cycles (about 2 minutes) of CPR before applying the AED
options.zh: 先做 5 个循环（约 2 分钟）CPR，再贴 AED

questions.explanationEn: Asphyxia arrest (drowning, hanging, airway obstruction, overdose) is hypoxic in origin: if alone with an AED, give 5 cycles (~2 minutes) of CPR before applying the AED. With two rescuers, one applies the AED while the other does CPR for the same period.
questions.explanationZh: 窒息性骤停（溺水、悬吊、气道梗阻、药物过量）源于缺氧：独自携带 AED 时先做 5 个循环（约 2 分钟）CPR 再贴 AED。双人时一人贴 AED、另一人同期做 CPR。

questions.questionEn: A 78-year-old was found submerged to the neck in a cold lake for an hour after a boating mishap. She is conscious, shivering, and breathing adequately. Which combined management is BEST?
questions.questionZh: 一名 78 岁老人翻船后在冰冷湖水中浸泡至颈部约一小时才被发现。她神志清楚、寒战、呼吸尚可。哪种综合处理最佳？

options.en: Sitting position at rest, wet clothes off, dried and insulated, gentle handling, transport
options.zh: 坐位静息、脱去湿衣、擦干并保温隔热、轻柔搬动、转运

options.en: Have her walk to the ambulance to generate heat
options.zh: 让她走到救护车上以产热

options.en: Hot shower on scene before transport
options.zh: 转运前先在现场洗热水澡

options.en: Supine with legs elevated and vigorous limb rubbing
options.zh: 平卧抬腿并用力搓揉四肢

questions.explanationEn: This combines near-drowning and hypothermia care: keep at rest, position sitting up, remove wet clothing and dry, maintain body temperature, and avoid rough handling. Exertion (walking) and vigorous rubbing risk circulatory collapse and VF in a cold patient.
questions.explanationZh: 这是近溺水与低体温处理的结合：静息、坐位、脱湿衣擦干、维持体温、避免粗暴搬动。让低体温患者用力活动（行走）或搓揉四肢有循环衰竭和室颤风险。

questions.questionEn: A 3-week-old slipped under the water in the bathtub. She is now apneic with a pulse of 50/min. The EMR should:
questions.questionZh: 一名 3 周大的新生儿在浴缸中滑入水下。现在呼吸停止，脉搏 50 次/分。EMR 应当：

options.en: Ventilate only — compressions require complete pulselessness
options.zh: 只通气——必须完全无脉才能按压

options.en: Begin CPR at a 3:1 ratio with ventilations; the AED is not used for neonates
options.zh: 以 3:1 按压通气比开始 CPR；新生儿不使用 AED

options.en: Begin CPR at 30:2 and apply adult AED pads
options.zh: 以 30:2 开始 CPR 并贴成人 AED 电极片

options.en: Perform back blows and chest thrusts first
options.zh: 先做背部拍击和胸部冲击

questions.explanationEn: For neonates (up to 28 days) the compression ratio is 3:1 and no AED is used. CPR begins when there is no pulse OR the pulse is below 60 with inadequate perfusion — an apneic neonate at 50/min qualifies. Drowning arrests follow the appropriate resuscitation guideline immediately.
questions.explanationZh: 新生儿（28 天内）按压通气比为 3:1，且不使用 AED。无脉【或】脉率低于 60 伴灌注不良即开始 CPR——呼吸停止、心率 50 的新生儿完全符合。溺水骤停应立即按相应复苏指南处理。

questions.questionEn: The first-line medication for anaphylaxis at the EMR level is:
questions.questionZh: EMR 级别处理过敏性休克（anaphylaxis）的首选药物是：

options.en: Diphenhydramine PO
options.zh: 口服苯海拉明（diphenhydramine）

options.en: Salbutamol by nebulizer
options.zh: 雾化沙丁胺醇（salbutamol）

options.en: Epinephrine IM
options.zh: 肌注肾上腺素（epinephrine IM）

options.en: Oral corticosteroids
options.zh: 口服糖皮质激素

questions.explanationEn: The anaphylaxis protocol for all licence levels directs: administer Epinephrine. Salbutamol (for residual bronchospasm) and diphenhydramine are ADDITIONAL PCP interventions given after epinephrine.
questions.explanationZh: 过敏性休克协议要求所有执照级别：给予肾上腺素。沙丁胺醇（针对残余支气管痉挛）和苯海拉明是 PCP 的附加干预，且都在肾上腺素之后。

questions.questionEn: How should a hypotensive anaphylaxis patient be positioned and moved?
questions.questionZh: 低血压的过敏性休克患者应如何摆位与移动？

options.en: Sitting upright, walked slowly to the stretcher
options.zh: 直立坐位，缓慢步行到担架

options.en: Standing, to keep the airway vertical
options.zh: 站立位以保持气道垂直

options.en: Any position of comfort, self-mobilizing
options.zh: 任意舒适体位，自行活动

options.en: Supine to support blood pressure — do NOT walk the patient
options.zh: 平卧以维持血压——【不得】让患者行走

questions.explanationEn: The protocol: position supine to improve blood pressure and do not walk the patient. Sudden upright posture or walking in anaphylaxis can cause empty-ventricle cardiac arrest from abrupt loss of venous return.
questions.explanationZh: 协议要求：平卧以改善血压，且不得让患者行走。过敏性休克时突然直立或行走可因静脉回流骤减导致"空心室"心脏骤停。

questions.questionEn: A 20-kg 5-year-old is in anaphylaxis after eating cashews. The correct epinephrine dose is:
questions.questionZh: 一名 20 kg 的 5 岁儿童食用腰果后发生过敏性休克。肾上腺素的正确剂量是：

options.en: 0.2 mg IM (0.01 mg/kg)
options.zh: 0.2 mg 肌注（0.01 mg/kg）

options.en: 0.5 mg IM — the same as an adult
options.zh: 0.5 mg 肌注——与成人相同

options.en: 2 mg IM (0.1 mg/kg)
options.zh: 2 mg 肌注（0.1 mg/kg）

options.en: 0.02 mg IM
options.zh: 0.02 mg 肌注

questions.explanationEn: Pediatric epinephrine: 0.01 mg/kg IM to a maximum of 0.5 mg, repeatable up to 3 times. 20 kg × 0.01 mg/kg = 0.2 mg. The 0.5-mg adult dose is reached only at ≥50 kg.
questions.explanationZh: 儿童肾上腺素：0.01 mg/kg 肌注，单次最大 0.5 mg，最多可重复 3 次。20 kg × 0.01 mg/kg = 0.2 mg。只有体重 ≥50 kg 才达到成人 0.5 mg 剂量。

questions.questionEn: The adult epinephrine regimen for anaphylaxis is:
questions.questionZh: 成人过敏性休克的肾上腺素给药方案是：

options.en: 1 mg IV push once
options.zh: 1 mg 静脉推注一次

options.en: 0.5 mg IM every 5 minutes, repeatable up to 3 times
options.zh: 0.5 mg 肌注，每 5 分钟一次，最多重复 3 次

options.en: 0.1 mg SC as a single dose
options.zh: 0.1 mg 皮下注射单次

options.en: 5 mg via nebulizer
options.zh: 5 mg 雾化吸入

questions.explanationEn: Adult dose: 0.5 mg IM every 5 minutes, may repeat up to 3 times. The IM route reaches effect in 5-15 minutes; IV epinephrine is not an EMR route for anaphylaxis.
questions.explanationZh: 成人剂量：0.5 mg 肌注，每 5 分钟一次，最多重复 3 次。肌注 5-15 分钟起效；静脉肾上腺素不是 EMR 处理过敏性休克的给药途径。

questions.questionEn: An 8-year-old was stung by a bee and the stinger is still embedded in his arm as hives spread. How should the allergen be removed?
questions.questionZh: 一名 8 岁儿童被蜜蜂蜇伤，毒刺仍留在手臂内，荨麻疹正在扩散。应如何去除过敏原？

options.en: Squeeze the stinger out between two fingers
options.zh: 用两指挤出毒刺

options.en: Leave the stinger in place until hospital
options.zh: 保留毒刺直到医院处理

options.en: Scrape the stinger off the skin
options.zh: 用刮的方式将毒刺刮除

options.en: Cut around it with a sterile blade
options.zh: 用无菌刀片切开取出

questions.explanationEn: The protocol: remove the allergen — scrape off any stinger(s). Squeezing with fingers or tweezers compresses the venom sac and injects more venom.
questions.explanationZh: 协议要求：去除过敏原——将毒刺【刮】除。用手指或镊子挤捏会压迫毒囊、注入更多毒液。

questions.questionEn: A 72-year-old with coronary artery disease is in severe anaphylaxis after an antibiotic injection: stridor, BP 78 systolic. Your partner hesitates to give epinephrine "because of his heart." The correct reasoning is:
questions.questionZh: 一名 72 岁冠心病患者注射抗生素后发生重度过敏反应：喘鸣、收缩压 78。搭档因"他有心脏病"而犹豫是否给肾上腺素。正确的判断是：

options.en: Withhold epinephrine — cardiac history is an absolute contraindication
options.zh: 不给肾上腺素——心脏病史是绝对禁忌

options.en: Give half the dose to be safe
options.zh: 保险起见给一半剂量

options.en: Give diphenhydramine instead
options.zh: 改给苯海拉明

options.en: Give epinephrine — there are no absolute contraindications in life-threatening anaphylaxis
options.zh: 给肾上腺素——危及生命的过敏性休克没有绝对禁忌证

questions.explanationEn: The monograph states: there are no absolute contraindications to epinephrine use in life-threatening situations such as anaphylaxis. Untreated anaphylaxis will kill this patient; standard dosing (0.5 mg IM) applies. Diphenhydramine is a PCP adjunct, never a substitute.
questions.explanationZh: 药物专论写明：在过敏性休克等危及生命的情况下，肾上腺素没有绝对禁忌证。不治疗的过敏性休克会致命；照常给 0.5 mg 肌注。苯海拉明是 PCP 的辅助药，绝不能替代。

questions.questionEn: A 6-year-old with a known peanut allergy has hives, audible wheeze, and is becoming sleepy with a weak pulse after exposure. Besides epinephrine, what is the correct EMR sequence?
questions.questionZh: 一名已知花生过敏的 6 岁儿童接触后出现荨麻疹、可闻及哮鸣，逐渐嗜睡、脉搏微弱。除肾上腺素外，EMR 的正确流程是？

options.en: Delay transport until a full 3 doses of epinephrine are given on scene
options.zh: 在现场给满 3 剂肾上腺素后再转运

options.en: Supine position, airway management and oxygen, epinephrine IM, then transport with continued treatment en route
options.zh: 平卧、气道管理与给氧、肌注肾上腺素，随后转运并在途中继续处理

options.en: Salbutamol first for the wheeze, then epinephrine if it fails
options.zh: 先给沙丁胺醇治喘鸣，无效再上肾上腺素

options.en: Oral antihistamine and observation at home
options.zh: 口服抗组胺药并留家观察

questions.explanationEn: The all-levels sequence: position supine (do not walk), complete a primary survey with airway management and oxygen to SpO2 ≥94%, administer epinephrine, and transport with continued assessment/treatment en route. Treating bronchospasm with salbutamol is a PCP step and only AFTER epinephrine.
questions.explanationZh: 全级别流程：平卧（不得行走）、完成初步评估并进行气道管理与给氧至 SpO2 ≥94%、给肾上腺素、随后转运并在途中继续评估处理。用沙丁胺醇治支气管痉挛是 PCP 步骤，且必须在肾上腺素【之后】。

questions.questionEn: Which combination marks an anaphylaxis patient as UNSTABLE under the protocol indications?
questions.questionZh: 按协议指征，哪组表现将过敏反应患者界定为【不稳定】？

options.en: Syncope, decreased LOC, BP below 90 mmHg, or respiratory distress
options.zh: 晕厥、意识下降、血压低于 90 mmHg 或呼吸窘迫

options.en: Localized hives at the sting site only
options.zh: 仅蜇伤处局部荨麻疹

options.en: Anxiety with normal vital signs
options.zh: 焦虑但生命体征正常

options.en: Itching that resolves with cold compresses
options.zh: 冷敷后缓解的瘙痒

questions.explanationEn: The protocol applies to suspected anaphylaxis with signs of anaphylaxis, exposure to an allergen, AND instability: syncope, decreased LOC, or hypotension (BP < 90 mmHg), or respiratory distress.
questions.explanationZh: 协议适用条件：有过敏反应征象、有过敏原接触史，且不稳定——晕厥、意识下降、低血压（BP < 90 mmHg）或呼吸窘迫。

questions.questionEn: In a suspected narcotic overdose with slow, shallow breathing, what must be established BEFORE naloxone administration?
questions.questionZh: 疑似麻醉药品（阿片类）过量、呼吸慢而浅的患者，在给纳洛酮【之前】必须先做什么？

options.en: A 12-lead ECG
options.zh: 12 导联心电图

options.en: Airway management and supported ventilations with oxygenation
options.zh: 气道管理并辅助通气与氧合

options.en: Two large-bore IVs
options.zh: 两条大口径静脉通路

options.en: A urine drug screen
options.zh: 尿液毒物筛查

questions.explanationEn: The protocol sequence: complete a primary survey ensuring the airway is managed (positioning, suctioning, adjuncts), ventilations are supported (consider two-person BVM), and oxygen is given to SpO2 ≥94% — then obtain history/vitals with BGL, and administer naloxone. Hypoxia kills before the antidote works.
questions.explanationZh: 协议顺序：先完成初步评估——管理气道（摆位、吸引、辅助气道）、支持通气（考虑双人 BVM）、给氧至 SpO2 ≥94%——再采集病史/生命体征（含血糖），然后给纳洛酮。解毒剂起效前，缺氧就能致命。

questions.questionEn: Beyond decreased LOC and depressed respirations, which sign is listed for opioid overdose?
questions.questionZh: 除意识下降和呼吸抑制外，阿片类药物过量还列出了哪项体征？

options.en: Widely dilated pupils
options.zh: 瞳孔显著散大

options.en: Hot, flushed skin
options.zh: 皮肤潮红发热

options.en: Pinpoint pupils (miosis)
options.zh: 针尖样瞳孔（miosis）

options.en: Hyperventilation
options.zh: 过度通气

questions.explanationEn: Listed signs and symptoms: pinpoint pupils (miosis), hypotension, hypothermia, and tachycardia — on top of decreased LOC and depressed respiratory drive with reduced rate and tidal volume.
questions.explanationZh: 列出的体征包括：针尖样瞳孔、低血压、低体温和心动过速——加上意识下降及呼吸频率、潮气量双双降低的呼吸抑制。

questions.questionEn: You gave 0.4 mg naloxone IM to an overdose patient. Three minutes later his SpO2 is 88% and he is ventilating at 8/min. The next dose is:
questions.questionZh: 你已给一名药物过量患者肌注纳洛酮 0.4 mg。3 分钟后其 SpO2 88%、自主通气 8 次/分。下一剂应是：

options.en: 2.0 mg IM immediately
options.zh: 立即肌注 2.0 mg

options.en: 4 mg IN
options.zh: 经鼻 4 mg

options.en: No further naloxone is permitted
options.zh: 不允许再给纳洛酮

options.en: 0.4 mg IM
options.zh: 肌注 0.4 mg

questions.explanationEn: The escalation ladder: 0.4 mg initially; if SpO2 ≥94% and ventilations >10/min are NOT achieved after 3 minutes, repeat 0.4 mg; after another 3 minutes 0.8 mg; then 2.0 mg. The second step is another 0.4 mg — jumping straight to 2.0 mg risks severe precipitated withdrawal.
questions.explanationZh: 递增序列：首剂 0.4 mg；3 分钟后若未达到 SpO2 ≥94% 且通气 >10 次/分，再给 0.4 mg；再过 3 分钟给 0.8 mg；之后 2.0 mg。第二步仍是 0.4 mg——直接跳到 2.0 mg 会诱发严重戒断反应。

questions.questionEn: The intranasal (IN) dose of naloxone is:
questions.questionZh: 纳洛酮经鼻（IN）给药的剂量是：

options.en: 4 mg
options.zh: 4 mg

options.en: 0.4 mg
options.zh: 0.4 mg

options.en: 10 mg
options.zh: 10 mg

questions.explanationEn: Naloxone dosing: 0.4 mg IM or IV per step in the titration sequence, but 4 mg when given intranasally (IN onset ≈3 minutes). The higher IN dose compensates for mucosal absorption losses.
questions.explanationZh: 纳洛酮剂量：肌注或静脉按滴定序列每步 0.4 mg 起，但经鼻给药为 4 mg（IN 起效约 3 分钟）。较高的鼻内剂量弥补黏膜吸收损耗。

questions.questionEn: An unresponsive suspected overdose patient has a blood glucose of 3.2 mmol/L. The EMR should:
questions.questionZh: 一名无反应的疑似药物过量患者血糖 3.2 mmol/L。EMR 应当：

options.en: Ignore the glucose — naloxone will fix everything
options.zh: 忽略血糖——纳洛酮会解决一切

options.en: Correct the low glucose (glucagon, given the unprotected airway) as well as administering naloxone
options.zh: 在给纳洛酮的同时纠正低血糖（气道无保护，应用胰高血糖素）

options.en: Squeeze oral glucose gel into his mouth while supine
options.zh: 平卧位直接往口中挤口服葡萄糖凝胶

options.en: Withhold naloxone until glucose normalizes
options.zh: 血糖正常前不给纳洛酮

questions.explanationEn: The overdose protocol requires a BGL with vitals and states: if blood glucose ≤4 mmol/L, correct the glucose level. In an unresponsive patient oral glucose is contraindicated (airway risk), so the EMR route is glucagon. Both problems are treated — hypoglycemia can mimic or compound the opioid picture.
questions.explanationZh: 过量协议要求测血糖并规定：血糖 ≤4 mmol/L 时应纠正。无反应患者禁用口服葡萄糖（气道风险），EMR 途径是胰高血糖素。两个问题都要处理——低血糖可模拟或叠加阿片类表现。

questions.questionEn: Two minutes after naloxone, your overdose patient wakes up combative, sweating, and vomiting, and demands to leave. This reaction is best understood as:
questions.questionZh: 给纳洛酮 2 分钟后，患者苏醒但躁动好斗、出汗、呕吐，并要求离开。对这一反应的最佳理解是：

options.en: An allergic reaction to naloxone requiring epinephrine
options.zh: 对纳洛酮过敏，需要肾上腺素

options.en: Evidence the diagnosis was wrong
options.zh: 说明当初诊断错误

options.en: Expected precipitated withdrawal — monitor closely, protect the airway, and encourage transport
options.zh: 预期中的戒断反应——密切监护、保护气道并劝导转运

options.en: An indication for another 2 mg of naloxone immediately
options.zh: 立即再给 2 mg 纳洛酮的指征

questions.explanationEn: Naloxone's listed adverse effects include reversal of narcotic effect with combativeness, signs of severe withdrawal, nausea, vomiting, sweating, and tachycardia. This is expected pharmacology, not allergy; the patient still needs monitoring and transport since naloxone may wear off before the opioid does.
questions.explanationZh: 纳洛酮的不良反应包括：阿片效应被逆转后的躁动好斗、严重戒断症状、恶心呕吐、出汗、心动过速。这是预期药理反应而非过敏；由于纳洛酮可能比阿片类先失效，患者仍需监护和转运。

questions.questionEn: An 80-year-old with cancer pain wears a fentanyl patch. Her family found her barely rousable, breathing 8 times per minute with small pupils. The EMR should:
questions.questionZh: 一名 80 岁癌痛患者使用芬太尼贴剂。家属发现她几乎唤不醒，呼吸 8 次/分，瞳孔缩小。EMR 应当：

options.en: Assume this is normal end-of-life sedation and only observe
options.zh: 当作临终正常镇静，仅观察

options.en: Give oral glucose for possible hypoglycemia first
options.zh: 先给口服葡萄糖处理可能的低血糖

options.en: Withhold naloxone because she has a legitimate prescription
options.zh: 因为是合法处方药而不给纳洛酮

options.en: Support ventilations, obtain vitals including BGL, and administer naloxone per protocol
options.zh: 辅助通气、测生命体征（含血糖），并按协议给纳洛酮

questions.explanationEn: Prescription opioids cause overdose too. The protocol applies to actual or suspected narcotic use with depressed respiratory drive: manage the airway, support ventilations, oxygenate, obtain vitals including blood glucose, and administer naloxone. Oral glucose is contraindicated in a barely rousable patient.
questions.explanationZh: 处方阿片类同样会导致过量。协议适用于实际或疑似麻醉药品使用伴呼吸抑制者：管理气道、辅助通气、给氧、测生命体征（含血糖），并给纳洛酮。几乎唤不醒的患者禁用口服葡萄糖。

questions.questionEn: A newborn is limp with depressed respirations shortly after birth to a mother who used opioids in labour. The EMR's PRIORITY is:
questions.questionZh: 一名母亲产程中使用了阿片类药物，新生儿出生后不久肌张力低、呼吸受抑制。EMR 的【优先】处理是：

options.en: Ventilatory support with a BVM following the newborn resuscitation steps
options.zh: 按新生儿复苏步骤用 BVM 提供通气支持

options.en: Immediate adult-dose naloxone IM
options.zh: 立即肌注成人剂量纳洛酮

options.en: Chest compressions before any ventilation
options.zh: 未通气前先做胸外按压

options.en: Oral glucose to boost energy
options.zh: 口服葡萄糖补充能量

questions.explanationEn: Newborn care is ventilation-driven: dry/stimulate/keep warm, then BVM ventilation on room air, adding oxygen and compressions only as the heart rate dictates. In any narcotic-exposure patient the airway and ventilations come before the antidote — especially in neonates, where resuscitation is respiratory first.
questions.explanationZh: 新生儿处理以通气为核心：擦干/刺激/保暖，然后 BVM 室内空气通气，之后视心率加氧和按压。任何麻醉药品暴露的患者都先保气道和通气再谈解毒剂——新生儿尤其如此，其复苏首先是呼吸性的。

questions.questionEn: A 40-year-old known diabetic is sweaty and confused but alert enough to follow commands and swallow. His BGL is 3.1 mmol/L. The correct EMR treatment is to:
questions.questionZh: 一名 40 岁已知糖尿病患者大汗、意识混乱，但仍能听从指令并吞咽。血糖 3.1 mmol/L。EMR 的正确处理是：

options.en: Apply glucose gel to the oral mucosa
options.zh: 将葡萄糖凝胶涂在口腔黏膜上

options.en: Administer glucagon IM
options.zh: 肌注胰高血糖素（glucagon）

options.en: Start an IV and give D10W
options.zh: 建立静脉通路并给 D10W

options.en: Withhold treatment until the BGL is below 2.0 mmol/L
options.zh: 等血糖低于 2.0 mmol/L 再处理

questions.explanationEn: Correct suspected hypoglycemia when BGL < 4.0 mmol/L: for patients with sufficient mentation to maintain an airway, apply glucose gel to the oral mucosa. Glucagon is for insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway; D10W by IV is a PCP intervention.
questions.explanationZh: 血糖 < 4.0 mmol/L 即纠正疑似低血糖：意识足以维持气道者，将葡萄糖凝胶涂于口腔黏膜。胰高血糖素用于意识不足或气道无保护者；静脉 D10W 属 PCP 干预。
questions.sourceRef: p.57 Diabetic Emergencies; p.76 Oral Glucose

questions.questionEn: A 76-year-old insulin-dependent diabetic is unresponsive with snoring respirations and a BGL of 2.4 mmol/L. Which treatment is within the EMR scope for this patient?
questions.questionZh: 一名 76 岁胰岛素依赖型糖尿病患者无反应、有鼾声呼吸，血糖 2.4 mmol/L。对该患者，哪项治疗在 EMR 权限之内？

options.en: Oral glucose gel placed under the tongue
options.zh: 把葡萄糖凝胶放到舌下

options.en: Glucagon
options.zh: 胰高血糖素（glucagon）

options.en: D10W 100-250 mL IV
options.zh: 静脉给 D10W 100-250 mL

options.en: Dextrose-sweetened juice poured into the mouth
options.zh: 往口中灌加糖果汁

questions.explanationEn: The Emergency Medical Responder intervention states: for patients with insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway, administer glucagon. Anything oral is contraindicated in an unresponsive patient (aspiration risk), and IV D10W is a PCP intervention.
questions.explanationZh: EMR 干预明确规定：意识不足或气道无保护的患者给予胰高血糖素。无反应患者禁止任何经口给药（误吸风险），静脉 D10W 属 PCP 干预。

questions.questionEn: You give oral glucose to a conscious hypoglycemic patient. Five minutes later he is still confused and his BGL is 3.4 mmol/L. According to the monograph, you may:
questions.questionZh: 你给一名清醒的低血糖患者服用了口服葡萄糖。5 分钟后他仍意识混乱，血糖 3.4 mmol/L。按药物专论，你可以：

options.en: Give one further dose only, then stop regardless of response
options.zh: 只能再给一剂，之后无论反应如何都停

options.en: Switch immediately to glucagon since oral glucose failed
options.zh: 口服葡萄糖无效，立即改用胰高血糖素

options.en: Repeat 15 g of oral glucose — it may be repeated at 5 minutes as necessary with no stated limit
options.zh: 再给 15 g 口服葡萄糖——按需每 5 分钟可重复，专论未设上限

options.en: Wait 30 minutes before any repeat dose
options.zh: 等 30 分钟后才能重复给药

questions.explanationEn: Oral glucose: 15 g PO, repeat at 5 minutes as necessary — no limit, provided the patient still has sufficient mentation to protect the airway. Continuous reassessment of mentation is essential before each dose.
questions.explanationZh: 口服葡萄糖：每次 15 g，按需每 5 分钟重复——无剂量上限，前提是患者仍有足够意识保护气道。每次给药前都必须重新评估意识状态。

questions.questionEn: An 82-year-old diabetic is unresponsive with a BGL of 2.0 mmol/L. Your EMR partner suggests establishing an IV and giving D10W. The correct response is:
questions.questionZh: 一名 82 岁糖尿病患者无反应，血糖 2.0 mmol/L。你的 EMR 搭档建议建立静脉通路并给 D10W。正确的回应是：

options.en: Agree — D10W is the fastest route for any provider
options.zh: 同意——D10W 对任何级别人员都是最快途径

options.en: Agree, but use D5W instead
options.zh: 同意，但改用 D5W

options.en: Agree and give the D10W intramuscularly
options.zh: 同意，并把 D10W 改为肌注

options.en: Decline — IV D10W is a PCP intervention; the EMR treatment here is glucagon
options.zh: 拒绝——静脉 D10W 属 PCP 干预；此处 EMR 的处理是胰高血糖素

questions.explanationEn: Obtaining vascular access and correcting hypoglycemia with D10W (10-25 g, 100-250 mL of 10% solution) are listed as ADDITIONAL Primary Care Paramedic interventions. The EMR intervention for a patient with an unprotected airway is glucagon (IM 0.5-1 mg, or IN 3 mg). D10W has no IM route.
questions.explanationZh: 建立血管通路并用 D10W（10-25 g，即 10% 溶液 100-250 mL）纠正低血糖列为【PCP 附加】干预。EMR 对气道无保护患者的干预是胰高血糖素（肌注 0.5-1 mg 或经鼻 3 mg）。D10W 没有肌注途径。
questions.sourceRef: p.57 Diabetic Emergencies; p.61 D10W; p.67 Glucagon

questions.questionEn: At what blood glucose level does the BC guideline direct the EMR to correct suspected hypoglycemia?
questions.questionZh: BC 指南规定 EMR 在血糖低于多少时应纠正疑似低血糖？

options.en: Below 4.0 mmol/L
options.zh: 低于 4.0 mmol/L

options.en: Below 2.0 mmol/L
options.zh: 低于 2.0 mmol/L

options.en: Below 6.0 mmol/L
options.zh: 低于 6.0 mmol/L

options.en: Below 8.0 mmol/L
options.zh: 低于 8.0 mmol/L

questions.explanationEn: The diabetic protocol directs: correct suspected hypoglycemia at BGL < 4.0 mmol/L. (The narcotic overdose protocol uses the same ≤4 mmol/L trigger, and PCP TBI management targets a normal range of 4.0-8.0 mmol/L.)
questions.explanationZh: 糖尿病协议规定：血糖 < 4.0 mmol/L 即纠正疑似低血糖。（麻醉药品过量协议采用同样的 ≤4 mmol/L 触发值；PCP 的 TBI 处理目标正常范围为 4.0-8.0 mmol/L。）

questions.questionEn: A 75-year-old is found slumped in a chair with slurred speech and right-sided weakness. There is no known cause for the decreased LOC. Before assuming stroke, the EMR must:
questions.questionZh: 一名 75 岁老人瘫坐在椅子上，言语含糊、右侧肢体无力，意识下降原因不明。在认定为脑卒中之前，EMR 必须：

options.en: Give oral glucose empirically to every such patient
options.zh: 对所有这类患者一律经验性给口服葡萄糖

options.en: Obtain a blood glucose level — decreased LOC without a known cause falls under the diabetic protocol
options.zh: 测血糖——原因不明的意识下降属于糖尿病协议范畴

options.en: Wait for hospital lab results before any glucose decision
options.zh: 等医院化验结果再决定是否处理血糖

options.en: Assume hyperglycemia and withhold all glucose
options.zh: 假定是高血糖，一概不给葡萄糖

questions.explanationEn: The diabetic protocol covers decreased LOC patients without a known cause, and a blood glucose check is a listed all-levels intervention in the stroke guideline too. Hypoglycemia is a classic stroke mimic — but glucose is given based on the measured BGL (<4.0) and the patient's ability to protect the airway, not empirically.
questions.explanationZh: 糖尿病协议涵盖原因不明的意识下降患者，脑卒中指南同样把测血糖列为全级别干预。低血糖是典型的"卒中模拟症"——但给糖依据实测血糖（<4.0）和患者气道保护能力，而非凭经验盲给。

questions.questionEn: Which dosing statement for glucagon is correct?
questions.questionZh: 关于胰高血糖素（glucagon）的剂量，哪项说法正确？

options.en: 5 mg IM, repeat every 5 minutes
options.zh: 肌注 5 mg，每 5 分钟重复

options.en: 0.4 mg IM only, no repeat
options.zh: 仅肌注 0.4 mg，不重复

options.en: IM 0.5-1 mg; IN 3 mg, repeat after 15 minutes if no clinical response
options.zh: 肌注 0.5-1 mg；经鼻 3 mg，15 分钟无临床反应可重复

options.en: 15 g by any route
options.zh: 任何途径均给 15 g

questions.explanationEn: Glucagon: IM 0.5-1 mg; IN 3 mg, repeat after 15 minutes if there is no clinical response. Onset and peak are both about 15 minutes with a 90-minute duration — it works by accelerating breakdown of liver glycogen, so it may be less effective in malnourished or alcoholic patients. (15 g is the oral glucose dose; 0.4 mg is naloxone.)
questions.explanationZh: 胰高血糖素：肌注 0.5-1 mg；经鼻 3 mg，15 分钟无临床反应可重复。起效与达峰均约 15 分钟，持续 90 分钟——其机制是加速肝糖原分解，故营养不良或酗酒患者疗效可能较差。（15 g 是口服葡萄糖剂量；0.4 mg 是纳洛酮。）

questions.questionEn: A 79-year-old hypoglycemic patient is drowsy and drooling after glucagon administration. While awaiting a response, how should she be positioned?
questions.questionZh: 一名 79 岁低血糖患者在给予胰高血糖素后仍嗜睡、流涎。等待起效期间，应如何摆放体位？

options.en: Sitting fully upright with the head flexed forward
options.zh: 完全直立坐位，头前屈

options.en: Supine flat with the head of the bed lowered
options.zh: 平卧且床头放低

options.en: Prone with the face down on a pillow
options.zh: 俯卧，面部朝下埋在枕头上

options.en: Lateral or 3/4 prone position, with suction ready
options.zh: 侧卧或 3/4 俯卧位，并备好吸引器

questions.explanationEn: The diabetic protocol directs that the patient be positioned in the lateral or 3/4 prone position if needed, with the airway managed by positioning, suctioning, and adjunct insertion as required. Glucagon commonly causes nausea and vomiting, so aspiration protection matters while waiting the ~15 minutes for effect.
questions.explanationZh: 糖尿病协议要求：必要时将患者摆成侧卧或 3/4 俯卧位，并通过摆位、吸引和放置气道辅助器具管理气道。胰高血糖素常引起恶心呕吐，等待约 15 分钟起效期间必须防误吸。

questions.questionEn: A 4-year-old with type 1 diabetes is pale and shaky after skipping lunch. She is awake, talking, and drinking from a cup. BGL is 3.0 mmol/L. The EMR should:
questions.questionZh: 一名 4 岁 1 型糖尿病患儿因没吃午饭而面色苍白、发抖。她清醒、能说话、能用杯子喝水。血糖 3.0 mmol/L。EMR 应当：

options.en: Apply glucose gel to the oral mucosa and reassess, repeating at 5 minutes if needed
options.zh: 将葡萄糖凝胶涂于口腔黏膜并复评，必要时 5 分钟后重复

options.en: Give glucagon IM because she is a child
options.zh: 因为是儿童就肌注胰高血糖素

options.en: Withhold glucose until BGL falls below 2.0 mmol/L
options.zh: 等血糖降到 2.0 mmol/L 以下再给糖

options.en: Start an IV for D10W
options.zh: 建立静脉通路给 D10W

questions.explanationEn: BGL < 4.0 mmol/L with sufficient mentation to protect the airway is treated with glucose gel to the oral mucosa, repeated at 5 minutes as necessary. Glucagon is reserved for insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway; IV therapy is a PCP intervention.
questions.explanationZh: 血糖 < 4.0 mmol/L 且意识足以保护气道者，用葡萄糖凝胶涂口腔黏膜，必要时 5 分钟后重复。胰高血糖素仅用于意识不足或气道无保护者；静脉治疗属 PCP 干预。
questions.sourceRef: p.57 Diabetic Emergencies; p.76 Oral Glucose

questions.questionEn: Which recognition tool does the BC stroke guideline name for accurate stroke identification?
questions.questionZh: BC 脑卒中指南指定使用哪种识别工具来准确识别卒中？

options.en: SAMPLE
options.zh: SAMPLE

options.en: FAST-VAN
options.zh: FAST-VAN

options.en: STAPLES
options.zh: STAPLES

options.en: AVPU
options.zh: AVPU

questions.explanationEn: Accurate recognition using FAST-VAN is a listed all-levels stroke intervention. (STAPLES is the Sager traction splint mnemonic and AVPU is the LOC scale — both are used for other purposes.)
questions.explanationZh: 使用 FAST-VAN 准确识别是卒中全级别干预之一。（STAPLES 是 Sager 牵引夹板口诀，AVPU 是意识水平量表，二者用途不同。）

questions.questionEn: Which pair of interventions is required for ALL licence levels in suspected stroke?
questions.questionZh: 疑似脑卒中时，哪一组干预是所有执照级别都必须执行的？

options.en: IV access and a fluid bolus
options.zh: 建立静脉通路并快速补液

options.en: Oral ASA and nitroglycerin
options.zh: 口服 ASA 加硝酸甘油

options.en: Supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 ≥ 94% and a blood glucose check
options.zh: 辅助供氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94% 并检测血糖

options.en: CPAP and a 12-lead ECG
options.zh: CPAP 加 12 导联心电图

questions.explanationEn: All-levels stroke interventions: assess and manage ABCs, supplemental oxygen to SpO2 ≥94%, position the patient, blood glucose check, accurate recognition (FAST-VAN), timely transport with notification of the receiving facility. Vascular access is an ADDITIONAL PCP intervention.
questions.explanationZh: 卒中全级别干预：评估处理 ABC、辅助供氧维持 SpO2 ≥94%、摆好体位、测血糖、用 FAST-VAN 准确识别、及时转运并通知接收机构。建立血管通路属 PCP【附加】干预。

questions.questionEn: You recognize an acute stroke in a 71-year-old whose symptoms began 40 minutes ago. Regarding the receiving facility, the EMR should:
questions.questionZh: 你识别出一名 71 岁患者 40 分钟前发病的急性脑卒中。关于接收医院，EMR 应当：

options.en: Say nothing until arrival to avoid tying up the radio
options.zh: 为不占用无线电，到院前不做任何通报

options.en: Notify only if the patient deteriorates during transport
options.zh: 只有患者途中恶化才通报

options.en: Ask the family to phone the hospital themselves
options.zh: 让家属自己打电话给医院

options.en: Notify the receiving facility while en route
options.zh: 在转运途中即通知接收机构

questions.explanationEn: The guideline lists "timely transport, notify receiving facility while en route" as an all-levels intervention. Pre-notification lets the stroke team mobilize imaging and thrombolysis/thrombectomy decisions before arrival — time is brain.
questions.explanationZh: 指南将"及时转运，途中通知接收机构"列为全级别干预。提前通报可让卒中团队在患者到达前就调动影像检查并准备溶栓/取栓决策——时间就是脑组织。

questions.questionEn: A 68-year-old has new facial droop and arm weakness with otherwise normal vital signs. For examination purposes, how should this patient be classified?
questions.questionZh: 一名 68 岁患者新发面部下垂和上肢无力，其余生命体征正常。就考试判断而言，该患者应如何分类？

options.en: Unstable — suspected CVA is a listed unstable primary survey finding
options.zh: 不稳定——疑似脑血管意外（CVA）是明列的初步评估不稳定表现

options.en: Stable — vital signs are normal
options.zh: 稳定——生命体征正常

options.en: Stable — a deficit must last over 24 hours to matter
options.zh: 稳定——功能缺损须持续 24 小时以上才有意义

options.en: Unstable only after the deficit worsens
options.zh: 只有缺损加重后才算不稳定

questions.explanationEn: Suspected CVA is explicitly listed among the primary survey findings that make an adult patient unstable — as are new onset neurological deficits. Normal vitals do not make a stroke patient stable; transport appropriately and notify.
questions.explanationZh: 疑似 CVA 明确列于使成人患者不稳定的初步评估表现之中——新发神经功能缺损同样如此。生命体征正常并不能使卒中患者变为稳定；应相应转运并通报。
questions.sourceRef: p.7 Findings in Unstable Adult Patients; p.30

questions.questionEn: Which finding is listed as an indication under the BC stroke guideline?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪项表现被 BC 脑卒中指南列为适用指征？

options.en: Bilateral ankle swelling
options.zh: 双踝水肿

options.en: Any neurological deficits
options.zh: 任何神经功能缺损

options.en: Fever above 38°C
options.zh: 体温超过 38°C

options.en: A productive cough for three days
options.zh: 咳嗽咳痰三天

questions.explanationEn: The listed stroke indications are: any neurological deficits; altered LOC or unconsciousness; difficulty maintaining the airway; shortness of breath, noisy or absent respirations; and a weak, rapid or absent radial pulse.
questions.explanationZh: 卒中指南列出的指征为：任何神经功能缺损；意识改变或昏迷；气道维持困难；呼吸困难、呼吸有杂音或呼吸停止；桡动脉搏动微弱、急促或消失。

questions.questionEn: A 70-year-old presents with sudden left-sided weakness and slurred speech. His BGL comes back at 2.8 mmol/L and he is alert enough to swallow safely. The EMR should:
questions.questionZh: 一名 70 岁患者突发左侧肢体无力、言语含糊。测得血糖 2.8 mmol/L，且他清醒程度足以安全吞咽。EMR 应当：

options.en: Ignore the glucose and transport as a stroke only
options.zh: 不理会血糖，仅按卒中转运

options.en: Give glucagon IM because stroke symptoms are present
options.zh: 因为有卒中症状就肌注胰高血糖素

options.en: Treat the hypoglycemia with oral glucose gel and continue stroke assessment and transport
options.zh: 用口服葡萄糖凝胶纠正低血糖，同时继续卒中评估与转运

options.en: Withhold both glucose and transport until symptoms resolve
options.zh: 在症状缓解前既不给糖也不转运

questions.explanationEn: A blood glucose check is a mandated stroke intervention precisely because hypoglycemia can produce focal deficits that mimic stroke. BGL <4.0 with sufficient mentation is corrected with oral glucose gel. Stroke has not been excluded, so assessment, notification and timely transport continue regardless of the glucose response.
questions.explanationZh: 卒中处理强制测血糖，正是因为低血糖可产生类似卒中的局灶性缺损。血糖 <4.0 且意识足够者用口服葡萄糖凝胶纠正。卒中并未被排除，因此无论血糖纠正后反应如何，评估、通报和及时转运都要继续。

questions.questionEn: A 58-year-old stroke patient is drooling, has noisy gurgling respirations, and cannot swallow. The EMR's immediate priority is to:
questions.questionZh: 一名 58 岁卒中患者流涎、呼吸有咕噜声、无法吞咽。EMR 的即刻优先处理是：

options.en: Give oral ASA to treat the stroke
options.zh: 给口服 ASA 治疗卒中

options.en: Give oral glucose in case of hypoglycemia
options.zh: 以防低血糖而给口服葡萄糖

options.en: Sit him fully upright and have him drink water
options.zh: 让他完全坐直并喝水

options.en: Manage the airway with positioning and suctioning, and oxygenate to SpO2 ≥ 94%
options.zh: 通过摆位和吸引管理气道，并给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%

questions.explanationEn: Difficulty maintaining the airway is itself a stroke indication, and the all-levels interventions begin with assessing and managing ABCs, positioning the patient, and maintaining SpO2 ≥94%. Nothing is given by mouth to a patient who cannot swallow; ASA is for cardiac ischemia, not stroke.
questions.explanationZh: 气道维持困难本身就是卒中指征，全级别干预以评估处理 ABC、摆好体位、维持 SpO2 ≥94% 为首。无法吞咽者禁止经口给任何东西；ASA 用于心肌缺血而非卒中。

questions.questionEn: Which stroke care step is listed as an ADDITIONAL Primary Care Paramedic intervention rather than an EMR one?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪项卒中处理步骤属于 PCP【附加】干预而非 EMR 干预？

options.en: Obtaining vascular access en route with an 18 G above the wrist, preferably on the right
options.zh: 途中建立血管通路：腕以上、18 G，最好在右侧

options.en: Checking the blood glucose
options.zh: 检测血糖

options.en: Positioning the patient
options.zh: 摆放患者体位

options.en: Notifying the receiving facility en route
options.zh: 途中通知接收机构

questions.explanationEn: The stroke guideline's PCP-only addition is: (en route) obtain vascular access — select a site above the level of the wrist using an 18 G, preferably on the right side. Glucose checks, positioning, oxygen, recognition and notification are all-levels interventions an EMR performs.
questions.explanationZh: 卒中指南中 PCP 专属的附加项是：（途中）建立血管通路——选择腕以上部位，使用 18 G，最好在右侧。测血糖、摆位、给氧、识别和通报都是 EMR 也要做的全级别干预。

questions.questionEn: You have recognized a stroke, secured the airway, applied oxygen, and checked the BGL on a 60-year-old whose symptoms started 25 minutes ago. Your partner wants to complete a full head-to-toe exam on scene first. The best decision is:
questions.questionZh: 对一名 25 分钟前发病的 60 岁卒中患者，你已完成识别、气道处理、给氧和测血糖。搭档想先在现场做完整的头到脚检查。最佳决定是：

options.en: Agree — a complete exam on scene is required before any stroke transport
options.zh: 同意——卒中转运前必须在现场完成全面检查

options.en: Agree, but shorten it to the neurological system only
options.zh: 同意，但只查神经系统

options.en: Begin timely transport now, notify the receiving facility, and complete the remaining assessment en route
options.zh: 立即开始及时转运，通知接收机构，其余评估在途中完成

options.en: Stay on scene and re-check the FAST-VAN every five minutes until it changes
options.zh: 留在现场，每 5 分钟重复 FAST-VAN 直到出现变化

questions.explanationEn: Suspected CVA is an unstable finding and timely transport with en-route notification is a listed intervention. The assessment model explicitly allows load and transport at any time after the decision point when the patient's condition warrants; remaining assessment continues en route.
questions.explanationZh: 疑似 CVA 属不稳定表现，及时转运并途中通报是明列干预。评估模型明确指出：当病情需要时，可在"决策点"之后的任何时间装车转运；其余评估在途中继续完成。
questions.sourceRef: p.30 Stroke; p.6 Patient Assessment Model footnote; p.7

questions.questionEn: Which statement about ASA in suspected cardiac chest pain is correct?
questions.questionZh: 关于疑似心源性胸痛使用 ASA（阿司匹林），哪项说法正确？

options.en: 325 mg swallowed whole with water
options.zh: 325 mg 用水整片吞服

options.en: 160 mg, but only after a full 12-lead ECG
options.zh: 160 mg，但必须先做完 12 导联心电图

options.en: 81 mg dissolved under the tongue
options.zh: 81 mg 舌下含化

options.en: 160 mg PO chewed and swallowed; it is the only medication that does not require vitals prior to administration
options.zh: 160 mg 口服嚼碎咽下；它是唯一给药前不要求先测生命体征的药物

questions.explanationEn: ASA is dosed at 160 mg PO, chewed and swallowed (onset 20 minutes to one hour when chewed), and the monograph notes it is the only medication for which vital signs are not required prior to administration. It should still follow the rapid body survey with cautions and contraindications checked.
questions.explanationZh: ASA 剂量为 160 mg 口服、嚼碎咽下（嚼服起效 20 分钟至 1 小时），专论指出它是唯一给药前不要求先测生命体征的药物。但仍应在快速全身检查（RBS）之后给予，并核对慎用与禁忌事项。
questions.sourceRef: p.60 Aspirin (ASA); p.47 Cardiac Chest Pain

questions.questionEn: Which patient has a listed contraindication to ASA?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪名患者存在明列的 ASA 禁忌证？

options.en: A 55-year-old with chest pain who takes a daily multivitamin
options.zh: 每天服复合维生素、现有胸痛的 55 岁患者

options.en: A 9-year-old with viral symptoms
options.zh: 有病毒感染症状的 9 岁儿童

options.en: A 60-year-old whose chest pain began 20 minutes ago
options.zh: 胸痛 20 分钟前开始的 60 岁患者

options.en: A 62-year-old with well-controlled hypertension
options.zh: 高血压控制良好的 62 岁患者

questions.explanationEn: Listed ASA contraindications: inability to swallow/allergy, active peptic ulcer or GI bleeding, having already taken the recommended dose, asthma induced by salicylates or NSAIDs, and pediatric patients with viral symptoms (Reye syndrome risk). Anticoagulant use and possible pregnancy are cautions, not absolute contraindications.
questions.explanationZh: ASA 明列禁忌：无法吞咽/过敏、活动性消化性溃疡或消化道出血、已服过推荐剂量、水杨酸类或 NSAID 诱发哮喘史，以及有病毒感染症状的儿童（雷氏综合征风险）。服抗凝药和可能妊娠属慎用而非绝对禁忌。

questions.questionEn: Which finding is a contraindication to nitroglycerin?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪项是硝酸甘油（nitroglycerin）的禁忌证？

options.en: A systolic BP of 130 mmHg
options.zh: 收缩压 130 mmHg

options.en: A heart rate of 88
options.zh: 心率 88

options.en: Sildenafil (Viagra) taken within the past 24 hours
options.zh: 过去 24 小时内使用过西地那非（伟哥/Viagra）

options.en: A nitroglycerin patch already applied to the chest
options.zh: 胸前已贴有硝酸甘油贴剂

questions.explanationEn: Nitroglycerin contraindications: systolic BP < 110 mmHg, known nitrate allergy, HR < 50 or > 150, and use of Viagra or Levitra in the past 24 hours or Cialis in the last 48 hours. An existing nitro patch does NOT change the protocol.
questions.explanationZh: 硝酸甘油禁忌：收缩压 < 110 mmHg、已知硝酸盐过敏、心率 < 50 或 > 150、过去 24 小时内用过 Viagra 或 Levitra，或 48 小时内用过 Cialis。已贴硝酸甘油贴剂并【不】改变协议。

questions.questionEn: A 69-year-old with cardiac chest pain has an SBP of 128 mmHg after his first 0.4 mg nitro spray. Five minutes later the pain persists and his SBP is 118 mmHg. The EMR should:
questions.questionZh: 一名 69 岁心源性胸痛患者在第一喷 0.4 mg 硝酸甘油后收缩压 128 mmHg。5 分钟后疼痛持续，收缩压 118 mmHg。EMR 应当：

options.en: Give a second 0.4 mg SL dose — SBP remains above 110 mmHg
options.zh: 再给第二剂 0.4 mg 舌下——收缩压仍高于 110 mmHg

options.en: Stop nitro permanently because the BP dropped
options.zh: 因为血压下降而永久停用硝酸甘油

options.en: Double the dose to 0.8 mg since the first was ineffective
options.zh: 第一剂无效，剂量加倍到 0.8 mg

options.en: Give Entonox immediately alongside the nitro
options.zh: 立即在硝酸甘油之外同时给 Entonox

questions.explanationEn: Nitroglycerin is 0.4 mg SL every 3-5 minutes provided the systolic BP remains > 110 mmHg, to a maximum of 3 doses in any 30-minute period. At 118 mmHg a second dose is appropriate. Entonox may only be given 5 minutes AFTER the last nitro dose (nitro within the last 5 minutes is an Entonox contraindication).
questions.explanationZh: 硝酸甘油为 0.4 mg 舌下，每 3-5 分钟一次，前提是收缩压保持 > 110 mmHg，30 分钟内最多 3 剂。118 mmHg 时给第二剂是合适的。Entonox 只能在末次硝酸甘油【之后】5 分钟才给（5 分钟内用过硝酸甘油是 Entonox 禁忌）。
questions.sourceRef: p.73 Nitroglycerin; p.47 Cardiac Chest Pain

questions.questionEn: A chest pain patient still hurts after 3 doses of nitroglycerin. Regarding Entonox, the EMR should:
questions.questionZh: 一名胸痛患者用完 3 剂硝酸甘油后仍疼痛。关于 Entonox，EMR 应当：

options.en: Give Entonox at the same time as the third nitro dose
options.zh: 与第三剂硝酸甘油同时给 Entonox

options.en: Give Entonox only after arrival at hospital
options.zh: 到院后才给 Entonox

options.en: Never give Entonox for chest pain
options.zh: 胸痛绝不使用 Entonox

options.en: Administer Entonox 5 minutes after the last dose of nitroglycerin
options.zh: 在末次硝酸甘油后 5 分钟给予 Entonox

questions.explanationEn: If pain persists beyond 3 doses of nitroglycerin, or if the SBP falls below 110 mmHg, administer Entonox 5 minutes after the last nitro dose — "nitroglycerin used in the last 5 minutes" is a listed Entonox contraindication. Entonox is indicated for cardiac pain where nitro is of no value or contraindicated.
questions.explanationZh: 若 3 剂硝酸甘油后疼痛仍存在，或收缩压降至 110 mmHg 以下，应在末次硝酸甘油后 5 分钟给 Entonox——"过去 5 分钟内使用过硝酸甘油"是 Entonox 的明列禁忌。Entonox 适用于硝酸甘油无效或禁忌的心源性疼痛。
questions.sourceRef: p.47 Cardiac Chest Pain; p.65 Entonox

questions.questionEn: A wheezing 8-month-old with a known history of bronchospasm needs salbutamol by nebulizer. The correct dose is:
questions.questionZh: 一名有支气管痉挛病史、正在喘鸣的 8 个月婴儿需要雾化沙丁胺醇。正确剂量是：

options.en: 5 mg
options.zh: 5 mg

options.en: 2.5 mg
options.zh: 2.5 mg

options.en: 10 mg
options.zh: 10 mg

options.en: 0.5 mg
options.zh: 0.5 mg

questions.explanationEn: Nebulized salbutamol: age > 1 year = 5 mg; age < 1 year = 2.5 mg, repeated as required. By MDI, patients under 10 kg are not indicated, 10-20 kg get 5 x 100 mcg per course and over 20 kg get 10 x 100 mcg, up to 3 courses.
questions.explanationZh: 雾化沙丁胺醇：1 岁以上 5 mg；1 岁以下 2.5 mg，按需重复。用 MDI 时：体重 <10 kg 不适用，10-20 kg 每疗程 5×100 mcg，>20 kg 每疗程 10×100 mcg，最多 3 个疗程。

questions.questionEn: What is the oral adult dose and 24-hour maximum for acetaminophen?
questions.questionZh: 对乙酰氨基酚（acetaminophen）的成人口服剂量和 24 小时最大量是多少？

options.en: 2,000 mg per dose; maximum 8,000 mg per 24 hours
options.zh: 每次 2,000 mg；24 小时最大 8,000 mg

options.en: 160 mg per dose; maximum 480 mg per 24 hours
options.zh: 每次 160 mg；24 小时最大 480 mg

options.en: 500-1,000 mg PO, may repeat once after 4 hours; maximum 4,000 mg in 24 hours from all sources
options.zh: 口服 500-1,000 mg，4 小时后可重复一次；所有来源合计 24 小时最大 4,000 mg

options.en: 300-400 mg PO; maximum 1,200 mg per day
options.zh: 口服 300-400 mg；每日最大 1,200 mg

questions.explanationEn: Acetaminophen: 500-1,000 mg PO, may repeat once after 4 hours, 24-hour maximum 4,000 mg from all sources and routes — lowered to 2,000 mg in suspected liver dysfunction, heavy alcohol use, or malnutrition. (300-400 mg with a 1,200 mg/day cap is ibuprofen.)
questions.explanationZh: 对乙酰氨基酚：口服 500-1,000 mg，4 小时后可重复一次，所有来源与途径合计 24 小时上限 4,000 mg——疑有肝功能不全、酗酒或营养不良者降至 2,000 mg。（300-400 mg、每日上限 1,200 mg 的是布洛芬。）

questions.questionEn: A 3-week-old infant weighing 4 kg is wheezing. Regarding salbutamol by metered-dose inhaler, the EMR should know that:
questions.questionZh: 一名体重 4 kg 的 3 周龄婴儿出现喘鸣。关于沙丁胺醇定量吸入器（MDI），EMR 应知道：

options.en: The adult dose of 4 x 100 mcg applies at any weight
options.zh: 任何体重都按成人 4×100 mcg 给

options.en: 10 x 100 mcg per course should be used
options.zh: 应按每疗程 10×100 mcg 给

options.en: 5 x 100 mcg per course should be used
options.zh: 应按每疗程 5×100 mcg 给

options.en: MDI salbutamol is not indicated under 10 kg — support the airway, oxygenate, and transport
options.zh: 体重 <10 kg 不适用 MDI 沙丁胺醇——应支持气道、给氧并转运

questions.explanationEn: The salbutamol monograph's pediatric MDI dosing states: < 10 kg — not indicated; 10-20 kg — 5 x 100 mcg per course; > 20 kg — 10 x 100 mcg per course. For a 4-kg infant the EMR manages airway and oxygenation (SpO2 ≥94%) and transports.
questions.explanationZh: 沙丁胺醇专论的儿童 MDI 剂量规定：<10 kg 不适用；10-20 kg 每疗程 5×100 mcg；>20 kg 每疗程 10×100 mcg。对 4 kg 婴儿，EMR 应管理气道与氧合（SpO2 ≥94%）并转运。

questions.questionEn: An 83-year-old on warfarin has moderate pain from a wrist fracture. Which analgesic choice best fits the monographs?
questions.questionZh: 一名服用华法林的 83 岁患者因腕部骨折有中度疼痛。按药物专论，哪种镇痛选择最合适？

options.en: Acetaminophen, because anticoagulant use is a listed ibuprofen contraindication
options.zh: 对乙酰氨基酚，因为服用抗凝药是布洛芬的明列禁忌

options.en: Ibuprofen 400 mg, since NSAIDs work better for fractures
options.zh: 布洛芬 400 mg，因为 NSAID 对骨折效果更好

options.en: Both ibuprofen and acetaminophen together at maximum doses
options.zh: 布洛芬与对乙酰氨基酚同时按最大剂量并用

options.en: No analgesia — analgesics are contraindicated over age 80
options.zh: 不镇痛——80 岁以上禁用镇痛药

questions.explanationEn: Ibuprofen contraindications include anticoagulants, active GI hemorrhage or ulcers, NSAID hypersensitivity, and pregnancy — so it is excluded here. Acetaminophen may be used (with the 24-hour maximum checked from all sources) and analgesia should be given PRIOR to movement in stable, appropriate patients.
questions.explanationZh: 布洛芬禁忌包括正在使用抗凝药、活动性消化道出血或溃疡、NSAID 过敏和妊娠——故此处排除。可用对乙酰氨基酚（须核对所有来源的 24 小时上限），且对稳定合适的患者应在【搬动前】给予镇痛。

questions.questionEn: Which of the following is OUTSIDE the EMR scope of practice?
questions.questionZh: 下列哪项【超出】EMR 的执业范围？

options.en: Applying a tourniquet to an uncontrolled limb hemorrhage
options.zh: 对无法控制的肢体出血使用止血带

options.en: Initiating an IV and giving a 20 mL/kg fluid bolus
options.zh: 建立静脉通路并给 20 mL/kg 液体冲击

options.en: Administering IM epinephrine for anaphylaxis
options.zh: 为过敏性休克肌注肾上腺素

options.en: Applying a pelvic binder to an unstable pelvis
options.zh: 对不稳定骨盆使用骨盆固定带

questions.explanationEn: Obtaining vascular access and fluid boluses (20 mL/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 mL) appear consistently as ADDITIONAL Primary Care Paramedic interventions. Tourniquets, pelvic binding, and IM epinephrine are interventions for all licence levels.
questions.explanationZh: 建立血管通路与液体冲击（20 mL/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 mL 复评）在各协议中一律列为【PCP 附加】干预。止血带、骨盆绑扎和肌注肾上腺素则是所有执照级别的干预。

questions.questionEn: A 45-year-old in severe respiratory distress from pulmonary edema has an SpO2 of 88% despite high-flow oxygen. Which statement about CPAP is correct for an EMR crew?
questions.questionZh: 一名 45 岁肺水肿患者严重呼吸窘迫，高流量吸氧下 SpO2 仍为 88%。对 EMR 组员而言，关于 CPAP 哪项说法正确？

options.en: EMRs may apply CPAP starting at 5 cmH2O
options.zh: EMR 可从 5 cmH2O 开始使用 CPAP

options.en: EMRs may apply CPAP only if the patient is over 13 years old
options.zh: 只要患者超过 13 岁，EMR 就可使用 CPAP

options.en: CPAP is a PCP intervention; the EMR should position the patient upright, maximize oxygen, and assist ventilations as needed
options.zh: CPAP 属 PCP 干预；EMR 应让患者坐直、最大化给氧，并按需辅助通气

options.en: CPAP replaces the need for oxygen at the EMR level
options.zh: 在 EMR 级别，CPAP 可取代给氧

questions.explanationEn: CPAP is designated a PCP intervention throughout the guidelines (CHF/pulmonary edema, SOB, and drowning protocols all list it under Additional PCP Interventions). The EMR manages this patient by positioning sitting upright with legs down, oxygen to SpO2 ≥94%, and assisted ventilations if the LOC falls or SpO2 stays below 94%.
questions.explanationZh: CPAP 在指南中始终标注为 PCP 干预（CHF/肺水肿、呼吸困难和溺水协议都把它列在 PCP 附加干预下）。EMR 的处理是：坐直、双腿下垂，给氧至 SpO2 ≥94%，若意识下降或 SpO2 仍 <94% 则辅助通气。

questions.questionEn: A 30-year-old with major trauma and signs of shock is being managed by an EMR crew. Regarding tranexamic acid (TXA), the crew should recognize that:
questions.questionZh: 一名 30 岁重大创伤伴休克征象的患者由 EMR 组处理。关于氨甲环酸（TXA），该组应认识到：

options.en: TXA should be given IM by the EMR if a PCP is delayed
options.zh: 若 PCP 到达延迟，EMR 应肌注 TXA

options.en: TXA is indicated for isolated traumatic brain injury
options.zh: TXA 适用于孤立性创伤性脑损伤

options.en: TXA can be given up to 12 hours after injury
options.zh: TXA 可在伤后 12 小时内给药

options.en: TXA is a PCP intervention given IV; the EMR controls hemorrhage, splints, keeps the patient warm, gives oxygen and transports
options.zh: TXA 是 PCP 的静脉给药干预；EMR 应止血、固定、保暖、给氧并转运

questions.explanationEn: TXA is delivered as 2 g IV push over 1 minute and appears only under Additional PCP Interventions. It is contraindicated in isolated TBIs, in patients under 12 years, and more than 3 hours after injury. The EMR's hypovolemia role is hemorrhage control, splinting the pelvis/fractures, supine positioning, warmth, and oxygen to SpO2 ≥94%.
questions.explanationZh: TXA 为 2 g 静脉推注（1 分钟内），仅出现在 PCP 附加干预中。禁忌包括孤立性 TBI、12 岁以下患者和伤后超过 3 小时。EMR 在低血容量中的职责是止血、固定骨盆/骨折、平卧、保暖并给氧至 SpO2 ≥94%。

questions.questionEn: An 84-year-old is unresponsive with a BGL of 2.2 mmol/L and no gag reflex. Which action is BOTH indicated and within the EMR scope?
questions.questionZh: 一名 84 岁患者无反应，血糖 2.2 mmol/L，无咽反射。哪项措施既有指征又在 EMR 权限之内？

options.en: Administer glucagon
options.zh: 给予胰高血糖素（glucagon）

options.en: Administer D10W 100-250 mL IV
options.zh: 静脉给 D10W 100-250 mL

options.en: Place 15 g of glucose gel in the cheek pouch
options.zh: 把 15 g 葡萄糖凝胶塞进颊袋

options.en: Administer ondansetron 4 mg PO to prevent vomiting
options.zh: 口服昂丹司琼 4 mg 预防呕吐

questions.explanationEn: The diabetic protocol's Emergency Medical Responder intervention is explicit: for patients with insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway, administer glucagon. D10W IV and ondansetron are PCP interventions, and oral glucose is contraindicated without airway protection.
questions.explanationZh: 糖尿病协议中的 EMR 干预写得很明确：意识不足或气道无保护者给予胰高血糖素。静脉 D10W 和昂丹司琼属 PCP 干预；无气道保护时禁用口服葡萄糖。
questions.sourceRef: p.57 Diabetic Emergencies; p.67 Glucagon; p.75 Ondansetron

questions.questionEn: An EMR crew is resuscitating a 10-day-old in cardiac arrest. Which action is BOTH correct for this age group and within the EMR scope?
questions.questionZh: 一组 EMR 正在为一名 10 天大心脏骤停的新生儿实施复苏。哪项措施既符合该年龄组要求又在 EMR 权限之内？

options.en: Apply the AED with adult pads and analyze
options.zh: 贴成人 AED 电极片并分析心律

options.en: Perform compressions at a 30:2 ratio
options.zh: 以 30:2 的比例进行按压

options.en: Perform CPR at a 3:1 compression-to-ventilation ratio with no AED
options.zh: 以 3:1 的按压通气比进行 CPR，不使用 AED

options.en: Establish vascular access for a fluid bolus
options.zh: 建立血管通路进行液体冲击

questions.explanationEn: For neonates (up to 28 days) the compression ratio is 3:1 and no AED is used. The 30:2 ratio is for adults and single-rescuer child/infant CPR outside the neonatal period, and vascular access is a PCP intervention.
questions.explanationZh: 新生儿（28 天以内）按压通气比为 3:1，且不使用 AED。30:2 适用于成人以及新生儿期之后的单人儿童/婴儿 CPR；建立血管通路属 PCP 干预。
questions.sourceRef: p.44 Neonate; p.41 Child Infant CPR/AED
